title: Aleniglipron Renal Impairment Study
official: A Phase 1, Single-Dose, Open-Label Study to Evaluate the Effect of Renal Impairment on Aleniglipron Pharmacokinetics
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effect of severe RI on IHD on the PK of aleniglipron to establish scientifically guided dosing recommendations in these special patient populations.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Is an adult, male or female, ≥ 18 to 85 years of age (inclusive), at screening.
2. BMI ≥ 17.0 and ≤ 40.0 kg/m2 and weight of at least 40.0 kg
3. Understands the study procedures in the ICF and is willing and able to comply with the protocol and communicate effectively with study personnel.
4. Group 1 only: Participant has severe RI maintained on stable regimen of high-flux HD at least 3 times per week for at least 3 months
5. Group 2 only: Has normal renal function with eGFR ≥ 90 mL/min

Exclusion Criteria:

1. History or presence of alcohol or drug abuse within the past 6 months prior to the dosing.
2. History or presence of hypersensitivity or idiosyncratic reaction to the study drug or related compounds.
3. Female participant with a positive pregnancy test at screening or at first check-in or who is lactating or breastfeeding
4. Has taken medications intended to promote weight loss within 3 months or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer, prior to screening, including, but not limited to GLP-1 RAs.
5. Received an investigational product in another clinical study within 30 days or 5 half-lives (if known) prior to first dosing, whichever is longer.
6. Has a history or presence of clinically significant medical or psychiatric condition or disease, any illness that, in the opinion of the PI or designee, might confound the results of the study or poses an additional risk to the participant by their participation in the study
